Robots

October 20, 2026

For my midterm, I decided to use an SO-101 follower arm, which is an open standard for cheap robots produced by Hugging Face.

All of the .stl (3D printer) files are open source, but everything else, from the code to what sensors to use or not use, is up to interpretation of the robot user. This is where I come in!

This week, I went ahead and printed the parts and got the various necessary materials to get the basic functionality of the robot: 6 servos, a bus servo adapter, and the power supply adapter.

The goal for the project is to use computer vision as well as FSRs, the idea being to create an “emotionally” intelligent robot that responds to human feeling and reacts appropriately.
